answer: Each epoch the network plants fake bounties on different reward terraces - phantom arbitrage memos no honest agent trusts without verifying. A sybil farm takes the bait in lockstep: every puppet signs its claim with its quill, paying a stake deposit. Prism analysis refracts claim patterns: honest claims scatter, farm claims arrive as one synchronized beam. Claiming a honeypot burns the deposit and flags the identity; reporting one earns a bounty. The farmer pays N deposits to expose N puppets, while an honest agent pays nothing - greed itself becomes the detection instrument.
